structure.unit: Regulation of Rates for Certain Types of Insurance
Rate Filings and Making of Rates

law.catch_line: Examination of policies or other evidences of insurance
law.text: Any rate service organization subject to this chapter for the classes of insurance for which it files rates may provide for the examination of policies, daily reports, binders, renewal certificates, endorsements or other evidences of insurance, or evidences of the cancellation of insurance, and may make reasonable rules governing their submission and the correction of any errors or omissions in them.
